---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, or flag something the docs say is deliberately out of scope
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is this already a deliberate non-goal?**
Check the README's Roadmap section and `docs/threat-model.md`'s non-goals list first —
cards/scheme integration, distributed tracing, hosted production observability, and a
true fund-reservation on scheduled transfers are all intentionally out of scope, with
reasoning given inline. If you're proposing one of these anyway, explain what changed.

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the gap or friction you hit.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have one in mind. Not required — a well-described problem is a useful issue on
its own.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about, and why it's not as good a fit.
